cases.statement: One carrier in the batch: Patient 4 of 40859316 (Chinese boy, onset 6 months). A second reported carrier, Patient 2 of 41890736, is not in the batch (see concerns).

people.label: Patient 4
people.key_phenotypes: onset 6 months; recurrent fever; abdominal pain/diarrhoea; multiple colonic ulcers; dark red maculopapular skin eruption; transient liver injury (ALT 165.6, AST 172.9); recurrent infections

quotes.quote: | Age of onset | 11 months | 2 months | 10 months | 6 months |
Patient 4: Dark red maculopapular lesions, slightly raised with erythematous halos; no nodules, ulceration, or tenderness (Fig. 4B).
Liver enzymes (ALT/AST) were elevated only in Patient 4 (ALT: 165.6 U/L; AST: 172.9 U/L).
Patient 4 experienced recurrent infections but showed gradual improvement in liver function and gastrointestinal symptoms.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Infantile-onset fever with colitis, skin eruption and liver injury. Autoantibody, pathogen and skin prick tests were negative. No other candidate variants are reported.

quotes.quote: Autoantibody panels, rheumatoid factor, skin prick test and pathogen screening were negative.

de_novo.statement: Both parents tested by WES with Sanger validation and wild-type. Parentage confirmation not reported.

quotes.quote: C WES reveals a de novo frameshift mutation in TNFAIP3 (c.1243_1247del) in Patient 4, with both parents showing wild-type sequences
Candidate variants underwent validation via Sanger sequencing to confirm their genetic origin.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Five-nucleotide deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Asn416ThrfsTer11)). The authors say it keeps the OTU and ZnF1 domains and removes ZnF2-ZnF7.

quotes.quote: This mutation preserved the OTU and ZnF1, resulting only in the loss of ZnF2-ZnF7.

population_data_in_papers.statement: Table 3 gives a minor allele frequency of 0.00001 for this variant (source database not named).

authors_classification.statement: ACMG-based classification with criteria, as stated by the authors.

quotes.quote: Variants c.866delA (PVS1_Very strong + PS2_Moderate + PM2_Supporting), c.133C > T (PVS1_Very strong + PS2_Moderate + PM2_Supporting) and c.1243_1247del (PVS1_Very strong + PS2_Moderate + PM2_Supporting) were classified as pathogenic per ACMG criteria

concerns: CARRIER MISSING FROM BATCH: 41890736 (in this batch's paper set) reports Patient 2, male, 6 months at genetic diagnosis, with c.1243_1247delAAAAC: p.N416Tfs*11, de novo (NM_006290.5). That paper's Table 3 compares him with 'the case reported by Xue et al' (this Patient 4). The extraction file holds this row, but it was not linked to this candidate, perhaps because of the 'delAAAAC' notation.

POSSIBLE SAME PERSON: 41890736 Patient 2 and 40859316 Patient 4 are both boys aged about 6 months, from the same region. Both have hemoglobin 110 and skin lesions. The two series share at least one child (identical laboratory values for the c.133C>T girl). 41890736 nevertheless presents them as separate cases.

40859316 uses two notations: c.1243_1247del (text, Figure 4) and c.1247_1251del (Table 3). They probably describe the same deletion in a repeat; the batch uses c.1247_1251del. The hg19 coordinates given (chr6:138199829–138199833) should be checked against the batch record.
Domain description differs within 40859316: Table 3 says 'ZnF1', and the text says 'between the ZnF1 and ZnF2 domains'.
41890736 also reports MMACHC variants and methylmalonic aciduria in either its patient 2 or patient 3 (the paper is inconsistent). If it is patient 2, the missing carrier has a second diagnosis.
notes_for_panel: For 41890736 Patient 2, quotes: '| Genomic location (GRCh37/ hg19) | c.866delA: p.H289Pfs* 3 | c.1243_1247delAAAAC: p. N416Tfs* 11 |...' (Table 1). The coordinator should decide whether to add this carrier or merge him with HA20-ID0385.
